name: zmodel_light_build_attr1_falloff
description: zModel_Light::BuildAttr1Falloff builds per-vertex fog falloff weights in g_Clip_PolyAttr2, updates lighting flag bit 1 for visible variation, and commits the current fog color.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zModel light fog helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel light/fog source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x489a90 validates the radial x/z distance approximation, distance and height fog falloff branches, clamp-to-[0,1] pass, visible threshold, variation flag bit 1, and fog color setter/commit calls.
The native smoke verifies attr2 falloff values, no-contribution and height-clipped flag clearing, visible variation flagging, fog RGB255 commit side effects, and uniform visible fog preservation.
